hypotheses.statement: Global crop median causes polarity inversion on dark-background crops causing zero mask in flat mode, and dilation without balloon interior barrier causes mask overflow past black stroke. Rigid ellipse in _clip_auto_mask_to_balloon additionally clips spiky/non-elliptical balloons.

Global crop median causes polarity inversion on dark-background crops causing zero mask in flat mode, and dilation without balloon interior barrier causes mask overflow past black stroke. Rigid ellipse in _clip_auto_mask_to_balloon additionally clips spiky/non-elliptical balloons.
Dynamic balloon interior barrier constraint resolves both dark-background polarity inversion and boundary stroke leakage.
